> JGR()


Copy the following into WordPad and save as "jgrLaunch.bat"

set R_HOME=C:\Utils - Finance\R-2.13.0
set R_LIBS=C:\Utils - Finance\R-2.13.0\library
set R_LIBS_USER=C:\Utils - Finance\R-2.13.0\library
jgr-1_62-x64.exe --rhome=C:\Utils - Finance\R-2.13.0 --libpath=C:

T:\My Docs\My R Files>set R_LIBS=C:\Utils - Finance\R-2.13.0\library

path=C:\Utils - Finance\R-2.13.0\library

Then a "non existent dir specified in rhome" windows pops up... I

me editing the jgrlaunch.bat.


Thanks in advance!!
